Hi Marcus,

I was thinking about how much we both need a change of pace, and I found something happening in the city that feels like it was designed for us. Since you've been complaining about being stuck indoors, this {{1}} provides the perfect excuse to spend an entire night under the open sky while the skyline glows around us.

I know how much you value sustainability, so you'll be happy to hear the entire production runs on {{2}}, which is pretty rare for something this high-energy. They've also set up a space where the art literally glows as you walk through it—I can already see you spending an hour there with your camera. If we manage to {{3}} before the month is out, we can keep some extra cash in our pockets for the {{4}} they're hosting, which apparently features dozens of different cuisines.

Since I still have my {{5}}, I might be able to snag a better deal on my entry, though I'm honestly tempted by the tier that lets us skip the crowds and maybe even rub elbows with the headliners. It starts just as the sun begins to dip, so we can watch the colors change before the heavy bass kicks in. What do you think?

Best,
Elena
